Tune data. A pattern is a byte list: $ff ends it, $80-$fe selects instrument (byte AND $7f), other bytes start a note of two bytes. Note byte: bits 0-3 note (0 rest, 1-12 C to B), bits 4-6 octave. Duration byte: bits 0-3 index music_durations. Duration bit 6 keeps the gate on and lets a slide instrument glide into the next note. Bit 7 glides only; no pattern uses it.
